profile.ja: ゆきかぜの幼馴染で姉のような存在。秋山達郎は弟。太刀の使い手。忍の里に代々伝わる剣術『逸刀流』の皆伝。“斬鬼の対魔忍”と恐れられる手練の美しき剣客。妹（ゆきかぜ）と弟（達郎）の世話をやくのが趣味で二人にとことん優しく包容力があり甘いところが多々あるが、それは二人だけに見せる一面で、学園の評判では強く美しく厳しい先輩として見られている。恋愛より妹弟を愛でるのが楽しいためか、数多の男子の求愛にまったく興味を示さない。女子生徒の中でも絶大な人気があり、秘かに凜子様ファンクラブなるものが存在し強い広がりを見せている。常にゆきかぜと行動をともにし、彼女を献身的にサポートしている。
profile.en: She is Mizuki Yukikaze's childhood friend and something of an older sister to her. Akiyama Tatsuro is her younger brother. She wields the tachi and is a master of the sword style "Itsutō-ryū," a tradition passed down through generations of ninjas. Feared as the "Demon-slaying Taimanin," she is a skilled and beautiful swordswoman. Her hobby is caring for her sister and brother, and she showers them with overwhelming kindness and affection—though this sweet side is shown only to them. At the academy she is regarded as a strong, beautiful, and strict senior. She shows no interest in the countless suitors pursuing her, preferring to dote on her siblings instead. Among the female students she enjoys immense popularity, and a secret "Lady Rinko fan club" has begun to spread widely. She is constantly by Mizuki Yukikaze's side, devotedly supporting her.

text.ja: 「対魔忍秋山凜子だ。剣の腕には自信がある、よろしく頼むぞ」
text.en: I'm Taimanin Akiyama Rinko. I'm confident in my swordsmanship—nice to meet you.

text.ja: 私はここで待機している。用があれば遠慮無く声をかけてくれ
text.en: I'm waiting here. If you need anything, just call out to me.

text.ja: 落ち着きがないな。もっとどっしりと構えていてくれなければ困る
text.en: You're so restless. I'd be in trouble if you don't stand more solidly.

text.ja: ふふふ、なんだ相談か？　私でよければ聞くぞ？
text.en: Hehe, what's the consultation? If you want me, I'll listen.

text.ja: 肩凝り……？　鍛錬をしていればそんな物は無縁だが、なんでそう思ったんだ？
text.en: Stiff shoulders...? If you're training you shouldn't have that, but why do you think so?

text.ja: 達郎がもう少し自分に自信を持ってくれると良いのだが……
text.en: I wish Tatsuro would have a little more confidence in himself...

text.ja: “斬鬼の対魔忍”と呼ばれる由縁となった剣の味、とくと味わってもらおう
text.en: Let me let you truly savor the taste of the blade that earned me the name "Demon-slaying Taimanin."

text.ja: 学校でゆきかぜが世話になっていると聞く。気は強いが優しい子だ、仲良くしてやってくれ
text.en: I heard Yukikaze is being looked after at school. She's strong-willed but a kind girl; make sure you get along with her.
